verdict.rationale: Vanta's own GRC page states you can cross-map controls across its pre-built frameworks, or customized ones, and 'automate across multiple frameworks without extra effort'. It also says controls are reused when adding new frameworks, and it covers SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA, so the core of the story is directly claimed. The evidence is marketing-level only. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the framework overlap is shown or visualized, in-depth docs on how evidence automatically satisfies mapped requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration.
